approved.en: Russian forces have stepped up strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, hitting a humanitarian hub, a hospital, a hospice and power plants, causing dozens of deaths and many injuries. Ukrainian drones are now being used to evacuate wounded troops from the front lines, while Russia has deployed heavily-armed drones and launched its largest mass attack on Ukraine's energy grid this year. The Oleshky ceasefire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces, and a Russian Su‑57 fighter was lost to an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: US President Trump announced that US military aid to Israel will end by year-end, while the UN rights office warned that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare. The Israeli Defence Forces identified senior Hamas commander Deif and other top leaders entering tunnels on the eve of the Oct. 7 attack, and separately killed six terror operatives in Gaza strikes this week. Israeli security forces carried out mass arrests across the occupied West Bank and rooftop settlers in Hebron threatened the city’s Palestinian identity, prompting Palestinians to return to ruined homes after a ten-day siege. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israels forsvarsstyrker identifiserte senior Hamas-kommandør Deif og andre toppledere som gikk inn i tunneler kvelden før angrepet 7. oktober, og drepte i tillegg seks terroroperatører i Gaza-angrep denne uken. Israels sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomførte massearrestasjoner på den okkuperte Vestbredden, og bosettere på taket i Hebron truet byens palestinske identitet, noe som førte til at palestinere flyttet tilbake til ødelagte hjem etter en ti-dagers beleiring. UCDP registrerte 21 440 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel continues air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon, killing a Hezbollah operative and wounding another, and setting homes ablaze, while Hezbollah fires artillery at Israeli positions. Lebanon reports a civilian killed and another wounded by an Israeli strike on a motorcycle, and another strike wounded one person. Hezbollah has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Libanon melder om en sivil som ble drept og en annen såret av et israelsk angrep på en motorsykkel, og et annet angrep såret én person. Hezbollah har begynt å distribuere sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Iraqi security forces have arrested high-value ISIS suspects in Kirkuk and captured a notorious ISIS gang member, while also foiling petroleum-product smuggling in territorial waters. Political arrests continue with the former Mosul Sports Club president jailed for embezzlement and a Najaf council member jailed for defamation. Politiske arrestasjoner fortsetter med den tidligere presidenten for Mosul Sports Club fengslet for underslag og et medlem av rådet i Najaf fengslet for ærekrenkelse. Sudan has lodged formal complaints against Ethiopia at the UN Security Council and the African Union over cross-border drone strikes. Displaced civilians returning to Khartoum and Darfur now face new challenges, including heightened famine risk in Kalma camp and survivors pledging to document killings after recent camp attacks. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sudan har levert formelle klager mot Etiopia i FNs sikkerhetsråd og i Den afrikanske unionen over grenseoverskridende droneangrep. The United States has withdrawn its forces from the strategic Baledogle airfield, and joint airstrikes by the US and an East African nation continue against an al-Qaeda-linked group.
